# Texture contract

**AMENDED 2026-09-02 (Nayan, mid-build):** v2 is a redesign — only the vision and the
story/narrative carry over from v1. There is NO art-bible gate, NO asset sign-off gate,
and NO forge/ComfyUI pipeline for v2. The build itself authors final art (procedural,
canvas-baked, painted-in-code, SVG) to the quality bar of the v2 spec docs. The bar:
every surface must read as painted art under the film transfer — boilerplate-procedural
looks are not final. The ★ checkpoints review the built result in the browser; that is
the only review surface.

Every texture the v2 build uses is registered here. Rows are added by the prompt that
introduces the surface; the stage that owns the surface owns authoring its final look.

- **slot** — the id the code loads the texture by.
- **surface** — what it dresses (ground, trunk, canopy, prop, board face, …).
- **resolution** — authored pixel size of the source map.
- **tiling** — repeat behaviour (tile / clamp / atlas region), with the repeat count.
- **status** — `placeholder` (temporary stand-in) → `authored` (designed to final quality in-build) → `final` (held a ★ review).

| slot | surface | resolution | tiling | status |
|------|---------|------------|--------|--------|
| trilayer-paint | paint layer of every trilayer surface (island ground cards, props) — gouache albedo with directional brushwork | procedural (flat palette fill; Lambert `map` is the hookup point — the hero's canvas bakes below plug in here) | tile (per-surface, TBD with real art) | placeholder (base slot; hero surfaces carry their own authored rows below) |
| trilayer-underdrawing | underdrawing layer — graphite strokes of the same forms + construction ghosts + battle-grid watermark (≤4% ink, enforced) | procedural (in-shader: albedo-tone strokes, one family; ghost rings; 1-unit grid). DISCRETE pencil rows: 13/world-unit across one stroke direction, per-row pressure/width, hand-bow along the row, dash lifts along the lead. P4c: ~20% rows skipped, a broad patch mask lets whole passages sit lighter (a hand shades in passages, not wall-to-wall), and the seam-frontier dither rose to 2.2 so paint breaks straight into strokes (the P4b half-mixed band rendered as a blank bleached strip). Form S committed (0.02–0.72). P4d: rows 26/world-unit, and the form tone QUANTIZES into 4 committed tiers (edges at tone .14/.30/.46/.62, paper-toned albedo left markless) that drive row width, skip rate, lead gaps, the patch mask and a near-solid core. The rows are TONE-FILL — forms come from the authored marks (hero-graphite-marks row). **P4e REPLACES the analytic rows entirely**: tone is carried by `bakeStrokeTiles()` — a browser-baked 1024² NoColorSpace mask holding four horizontal density-tier bands, each drawn as 15 rows × 1–3 passes of individual pencil strokes (7 tapered segments, per-stroke pressure/width/length/grey jitter, a slow bow, ±6.9° of hand variance around ONE family direction, ~5–45% of rows lifted off the paper, and rests between strokes). The P4d 4-tier quantizer is UNCHANGED and still picks the band; the tier edges get a light noise wobble so a boundary lands ragged rather than tracing the albedo's own edge. Projection: organic props opt into the rig's SHEET basis (one continuous param space and one direction for the whole prop); planar faces keep the dominant-axis plane. Two baked-in walk findings: `flipY = false` (the default flip made tier 4 sample the empty tier-1 band) and `anisotropy = 16` (grazing samples smeared at 4) | grid+ghosts: world-XZ, up-facing surfaces only (page furniture); strokes: sheet-plane per ORGANIC prop / dominant-axis planar per face otherwise, one family either way — exactly one texture2D sample per fragment | **authored (P4e — the texture half is now solved on the frame, not just in the code).** Judged as a stranger at 5× and 6× over the drawn ground, the graphite oak's lobes, the fir and the chest at 1440×900: strokes taper, rest and lift, and cluster denser where the tone is darker; no zebra bands, no fingerprint swirl on the lobed crowns, no barcode — it reads as graphite laid by a hand (walks/p4/p4e-verify-graphite-authored-zoom5x-1440x900.jpg). Value did not regress: p05→p95 spreads oak 136 / fir 152 / chest 147 / rock 160 / drawn ground 150 / far ground 122 at mean chroma 4.5–5.9. One residual, non-blocking: the authored CONTOUR lines over the tone render as a beaded dot-chain under magnification. Prior P4d verdict kept for history — VALUE authored, TEXTURE not. Measured at the shipped 1440×900 framing the tiers deliver real range (graphite masses p05→p95 spreads 157–166, mean chroma 4.6–6.0) and no two families ever share a fragment, so the hatch gate holds. But the committed cores render as hard black/white bands of near-equal duty cycle at ~2–5 screen px, and the per-face projection wraps each crown lobe in concentric swirls: the drawn half reads as engraving/wood grain rather than pencil (FINDINGS P4d-T1/P2c-T4; walks/p4/p4d-verify-graphite-props-zoom4x-zebra-1440x900.jpg). The low tiers on the flat ground card read acceptably as paper tooth; the tier-3/4 masses are the failure. Downgraded from P4c's `authored` on the frame, not on the code |

| hero-graphite-marks | the drawing half's authored marks (P4c rework — the drawn silhouettes ARE the forms now): view-plane `contourArc` scalloped crown outlines + interior leaf arcs + hero-weight trunk strokes on the graphite oak; a connected zigzag fir silhouette; `boxMarks` full box construction + lid end-arcs + crest/hem + strap lines on the chest; the bare path's drawn edge lines + first rut passes; rim contour whose unfinished gap now spans the whole graphite rim; strata section contours (graphite side) and their ink twins (painted side); measure ticks; construction ellipses; the half-contoured tree with its erased+redrawn line at graphiteDark/form. All marks ≥2 screen px (form weight) and depth-pushed via VIEW_CAM so solids can't swallow their own line; `inkEdges` survives only on faceted solids (the rock). P4d re-registered the contours to the silhouettes (oak lobe arcs at 1.05×/1.10× the lobe radius, pine skirt arcs 1.02/1.07, rim-mark jitter 0.035→0.012) and added per-segment root contours + bark streaks and 13 section strokes down the skirt | pencil.ts stroke geometry (LineSegments2), not a texture — registered here because it is the underdrawing's authored layer | authored, with one measured miss (P4d, all numbers at 1440×900): painted oak lobe arcs register 1–3 screen px off the paint edge inside a ±3–5 px roughen swing, and the far-right rim line 2–4 px — both hug. BOTH pines' zigzags do not: their authored radii exceed the stacked cones' silhouette, so the strokes sit 9–16 px outside the mass (10 px of bare paper measured on a scanline through the painted pine) — FINDINGS P4d-T2. Chest box construction, path edge lines, measure ticks and the erased-and-redrawn arc all read at framing; the underside section strokes read as ~4 pale scratches (P2-T1). walks/p4/p4d-verify-graphite-props-zoom4x-zebra-1440x900.jpg, p4d-verify-roots-underside-zoom4x-1440x900.jpg. **P4e re-derived the pine zigzags from the tier cone profile** (`silR()` over the stacked cones, skirt points at each cone's base radius, tucks proportionally inside) and dropped their VIEW_CAM push 0.3→0.1. Re-measured per scanline by isolating each prop's meshes against its two zigzag marks at 1440×900: graphite pine outward (left) side median 4px / max 7px of paper between line and mass over 94 of 126 rows, its inward side 0px; painted pine outward (right) side median 3px / max 10px over 128 of 175 rows, its inward side median 2px / max 3px. Line width 3px. Both firs are now NAMEABLE at the shipped framing — the wire-tent read is gone — and the residue is a lateral parallax shift from the surviving depth push, always on the side away from frame centre (FINDINGS P4d-T2, walks/p4/p4e-verify-pine-registration-zoom3.6x-1440x900.jpg).
